summary: Revolution Medicines filed an 8-K reporting that on October 8, 2026 it drew a $250 million Tranche A senior secured term loan from Royalty Pharma Development Funding under a June 23, 2025 loan agreement, paying a $5 million draw fee. The draw followed FDA approval of RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Interest is three-month Term SOFR (3.50% floor) plus 5.75%, interest-only with principal due October 8, 2032. Prepayment carries make-whole plus premiums of 3.0%/1.0%. Up to $500 million remains available on milestone conditions. This is routine financing, not a special situation.
